answer: To keep sybils unprofitable, a new identity may collect rewards only after locking a 1,200-unit copper bond for four epochs and receiving eight uniqueness attestations from established peers with mutually non-overlapping funding graphs. Each peer may pulse only one such attestation per identity per epoch, and only after verifying the lock transaction. If two identities are later shown to share a signer or deposit path, both bonds are slashed to a published basalt burn address and their attestations are reversed.
